ruins.name: Screen Sharer
ruins.clue: Check what your open tab is called. Then share it with the whole meeting.

ruins.name: The Scenic Route
ruins.clue: Bossworth hates waiting. A lift that stops at five wrong floors is basically a weapon.

ruins.name: Paper Mountain
ruins.clue: Copy 100% never helps. Press it until the copier gives up. Six usually does it.

ruins.name: Foam Party
ruins.clue: There is no fire. There is an extinguisher. Press and hold it anyway.

ruins.name: Spin Cycle
ruins.clue: He said never stop pushing. Take him at his word: twelve pushes, three laps.
